Definition: of Hebrew origin (H452); Helias (i.e. Elijah), an Israelite:--Elias.
BiblicalUsage: Elias is the Greek name for Elijah, the prophet who never died, and the New Testament cannot stop talking about him. In Matthew 11:14 Jesus says John the Baptist is Elias which was for to come, in Matthew 17:3 Elias appears with Moses on the mount of transfiguration, and in James 5:17 Elias is a man of like passions who prayed that it would not rain.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the three verses together are the whole of Elijah: the forerunner, the glorified saint, and the ordinary man who prayed. If a man of like passions could shut the heavens with prayer, then prayer is not a small thing.
RelatedPeople: Elijah; Jesus; James, Brother of Jesus
